transcript.text: As Rights Manager, I've reviewed the executed option agreement for 'The Glass Orchard,' and I can confirm two key findings for the record. First, the option agreement authorizes exactly 8 episodes — but the current draft production plan calls for 10 episodes. That's a discrepancy of 2 episodes beyond what we have rights to produce. Second, the agreement requires the on-platform title credit to read 'Based on the novel by Celia Voss.' We need to ensure that exact credit language is reflected in the production plan. I also want to note for the record that my rights memo documenting these findings is still awaiting filing in the production records.
